ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The figure has three consecutive origami schematic diagrams. The first shows a square sheet of paper placed in a diamond direction, and folded in half along the middle vertical line; the second shows the shape after the first fold, and there is also an arrow indicating carrying out the second fold in half; the third is the narrow long shape after the final folding, in which two gray shaded rectangles, upper and lower, can be seen, and the middle part is white. Reasoning: Each fold is a symmetric fold, does not change the total area of the paper sheet, and only overlaps regions originally in different positions together. According to the final diagram, the two visible shaded rectangles together correspond to one fourth of the area of the original square. The area of the original square is 64 cm², so the total shaded area is 64 ÷ 4 = 16 cm².

method.method_draft: Image: the three panels show the same square being folded twice, and the final panel leaves exactly two shaded rectangles visible. So the total shaded area is 64 ÷ 4 = 16 cm².
